items.label: Moderna Morgan Stanley conference 2026 (09-14-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Hoge on the intismeran (with Merck) program: the positive ph

set.signal: Hoge on the intismeran (with Merck) program: the positive phase III adjuvant melanoma interim analysis was a statistically significant and clinically meaningful result against KEYTRUDA, which he called the first time anybody has achieved that kind of benefit over KEYTRUDA in the adjuvant melanoma setting (company claim); the full data will be shared at an upcoming medical meeting. The adjuvant renal cell carcinoma and muscle-invasive bladder cancer phase II studies are fully enrolled and event-driven, and the non-muscle invasive bladder cancer monotherapy phase II is not yet fully enrolled; all three randomize approximately 300 patients one-to-one against standard of care (KEYTRUDA in the adjuvant RCC and MIBC studies); he highlighted RCC and MIBC as the more proximal readouts and said the NMIBC study could also read out in the near term. The lung program comprises three randomized phase IIIs being enrolled (event-driven) plus a large randomized phase II in frontline metastatic disease; Moderna and Merck have set up the program to deliver waves of clinical data every 6 months.

items.reason: Hoge said only the NMIBC study 'could readout in the near term'; RCC and MIBC were named as the more proximal readouts (the Q2 call puts MIBC more likely in 2027) - the entry extended 'near term' to all three.
items.evidence: we've highlighted RCC, renal cell carcinoma, and muscle-invasive bladder cancer ... also event-driven and also a phase II that could readout in the near term.

items.label: Moderna Bernstein forum 2026 (09-23-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Pipeline beyond intismeran: Berman - the off-the-shelf Lynch

set.signal: Pipeline beyond intismeran: Berman - the off-the-shelf Lynch syndrome neoantigen vaccine is in an ongoing phase I/II trial in the U.K. aimed at cancer interception (CEO Stephane Bancel: University of Oxford is involved, Moderna owns the program 100%, Lynch syndrome affects 1 in 400 people and a product could be offered through retail pharmacies); off-the-shelf shared-antigen cancer vaccines are in phase I; the multiplexed T-cell engager phase I in heavily pretreated multiple myeloma (three T-cell engagers in one drug, which he called a first) is progressing well, with data to be shared later this year. Bancel: the in vivo CAR T program for autoimmune disease is heading to the clinic, with progress on autoimmune programs to be shared over the next maybe 12 to 18 months.
set.figure: multiple myeloma T-cell engager data later this year; autoimmune program updates over the next maybe 12 to 18 months

items.reason: Hedge restored: Bancel said 'over the next maybe 12 to 18 months'.
items.evidence: So I think over the next maybe 12 to 18 months, we'll be able to share additional progress on where we're going with these other exciting programs.
